must_not_claim: I planned to become a writer
Bigfoot was the main creative project

turns.content: My creative awakening started with a late-night video about Bigfoot or Sasquatch. I was not looking for anything, but an AI writing tool surfaced in the related suggestions and I clicked it. I wrote a story that night. It was not good, but something underneath it felt like a door had opened. Now Aelith is past 160,000 words and Fractured Light has grown from that absurd beginning.
That sounds like an unlikely doorway into a much larger creative identity.
Why does the Bigfoot video matter to me?
